covers: Wall Street's first two hours and the JSE close on Thursday 12 November 2026 (to 18:52 SAST)
headline: Wall Street turns positive as chip rivals rally; Nvidia stays down about 5% after Huang's resignation; gold near a $3,870 low
summary: The S&P 500 (7,633.97) and Nasdaq (25,501.04) were 0.2% and 0.1% above Wednesday's closes at 18:52 SAST as AMD and Broadcom rose 5.8%, while Nvidia stayed down 5.4% at $164.40 (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 18:52 SAST). The JSE All Share ended at 112,894.87 and the Top 40 at 104,981.31, with gold miners down 3-4%, and the rand was at R16.78/$ (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026). Gold was at $3,872.30, 3.0% below Wednesday's $3,992.20, and the US 10-year yield rose to 5.09% from 5.00% (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 18:52 SAST).

items.title: Nvidia: Huang resigns, Kress interim CEO; Trump says Tim Cook should take over
items.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO and Colette Kress is interim chief. CNBC's live coverage reports President Trump saying Apple's Tim Cook should replace Huang. Nvidia was at $164.70 at 17:43 SAST, down 5.2% from Wednesday's $173.70 close, recovering from $159.28 (-8.3%) at 16:40 SAST.
items.source: CNBC headlines, 12 Nov 2026 16:39 and 17:40 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NVDA), 12 Nov 2026 16:40 and 17:43 SAST, and 11 Nov 2026 close

items.title: US existing-home sales fall to the lowest since 2010
items.summary: MarketWatch reports existing-home sales dropped to their lowest level since the Great Recession. The US 10-year Treasury yield was 5.07% at 17:43 SAST, up from 5.03% at 16:40 SAST.
items.source: MarketWatch headlines, 12 Nov 2026 17:01-17:08 SAST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 17:43 SAST (^TNX)

items.title: Nvidia: down 5.4% after the CEO resignation, while rivals rally
items.summary: The LRC Stock Scanner rated Nvidia HOLD (fair value) at Wednesday's $173.70 close; at $164.40 (18:51 SAST) the shares remain below the $210.96 price used in the LRC Watchlist investment list (23 Oct 2026), and did not join the wider market's recovery. The rating is unchanged here and is reassessed by the scanner on its next run. Results are still expected on 17 November.
